assessment.binding_constraint_summary: The broad product surface may overwhelm new users, burying the first success path.
assessment.defer_or_stop: Defer advanced features until the core value proposition is clear and adopted.
assessment.do_next: Collect feedback from early users to identify common pain points and refine the first-run path.
assessment.do_now: Streamline the initial user experience by focusing on one primary use case in the documentation.
assessment.next_test: Simplify the README to highlight a single clear use case and measure adoption rates.

assessment.binding_constraint_summary: The workflow depends heavily on expert rescue points for quality.
assessment.defer_or_stop: Defer further expansion until the workflow can produce high-quality outputs consistently without manual rescue.
assessment.do_next: Create reusable QA rules and templates from past audits to improve automation reliability.
assessment.do_now: Document hidden steps and silent failures to reduce reliance on expert memory.
assessment.next_test: Automate the JSON creation from analysis and validate visual polish across devices without manual intervention.

assessment.binding_constraint_summary: Agents can over-trigger skills, under-read them, or treat the skill as content to summarize instead of an operating procedure.
assessment.defer_or_stop: Defer adding new skills until adoption friction issues are resolved and circulation of learnings is improved.
assessment.do_next: Implement a feedback loop where task outcomes inform skill improvements, ensuring that high-quality task behavior is captured and integrated into the skills.
assessment.do_now: Develop clear guidelines for when and how to trigger each skill, emphasizing that skills are operating procedures rather than content to summarize.
assessment.next_test: Conduct a pilot with specific agents to observe and document how they use the skills in real tasks and identify common friction points.

assessment.binding_constraint_summary: Learnings from model runs are not consistently flowing into scripts, Verdict packs, model-selection docs, and automated checks.
assessment.defer_or_stop: Deferring further expansion until circulation issues are resolved.
assessment.do_next: Create automated checks to ensure that learnings are being captured and integrated into the workflow.
assessment.do_now: Document the current state of model routing, eval packs, prompt templates, timeout defaults, and fallback rules.
assessment.next_test: Implement a process to regularly update MEMORY.md and other relevant documents with learnings from each model run.
